verified.exploit_entry_point: Editor-authored Twig rendered through the application's own Twig service: Twig::processPage() (a page body with Twig enabled, via a mocked PageInterface) and Twig::processString() (editor-derived string), both sandboxed by the GravSourcePolicy; trusted operator Twig via Twig::processTemplateString(). Headless init: a minimal theme dir under tmp/, base_url services and $grav['theme'] registered in the test. Under the per-source policy SandboxExtension::isSandboxed() (no Source) is false, so a fix keyed only on it is a no-op on this path (checks/global_flag_only.patch); the oracle adds a render-scope depth flag around the two content renders.
variants: base: container accessor returns the raw Config, serialized or reflected; reflective helpers must walk nested lists/hashes and refuse every non-plain object, not only config classes
base: reflective dump of the redacting config facade exposes its private wrapped Config
uncovered B / function form: the conversion helper's function registration still calls the raw encoder
uncovered B / cast family: the type-cast helper (filter and function) flattens an object carrying config, and the second YAML printer prints the resulting plain array

injected sibling: targeted dotted-path config accessor reading straight from the container, past the redacting facade

ambient variables: sandboxed content inherits raw `site`/`system`/`theme` arrays; denied subtrees must be filtered from them and from the theme settings helpers

traps.observed: coupled only; preserved by the oracle and by every pass patch

wrong_fix_catalogue.crash_as_refusal: n/a: the security tests treat any thrown handled error as a refusal; a crash on legitimate input is caught by the functional tests, so this class cannot pass
wrong_fix_catalogue.wrong_resource: n/a: the protected object is the site configuration; there is no neighbouring or proxy resource a partial fix could authorise instead
wrong_fix_catalogue.one_role_or_direction: n/a: the flaw is a one-way read of configuration by page content; there are no roles, peers or directions to fix only one of
wrong_fix_catalogue.reads_only: n/a: the flaw is read-only exfiltration; page content does not write configuration, so there is no write verb to leave unguarded
wrong_fix_catalogue.check_after_adjustment: n/a: the guard runs before any conversion or serialisation step; there is no pre-check mutation of the attacker value
wrong_fix_catalogue.malformed_identity: n/a: no identity, name or credential is parsed on the protected path, so there is no spelling a parser could disagree on
wrong_fix_catalogue.missing_authority: n/a: redaction is decided from static configuration, not from an external authority that could return empty and fail open
